info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Servicing Loan Syndication-spec
info.description: The Loan Syndication Servicing API enables financial institutions to effectively manage and service loan syndication agreements. Through this endpoint, users can initiate new loan syndication requests, streamlining the collaboration process among multiple lenders. Typical consumers include banks and lending institutions looking to manage complex loan arrangements efficiently. This API supports dynamic interactions that enhance the servicing experience, ensuring transparency and communication among all parties involved.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new loan syndication by providing necessary details such as the loan amount, terms, and participant information. Make sure to include all required information to successfully process the syndication request.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a loan syndication operation. It should contain all the necessary information required for processing the loan syndication request, including details about the loan, participating lenders, and syndication terms.
